abstract: HIMSS analyzes the potential for AI-driven deep learning models to transform medical coding processes in healthcare. The research identifies that AI automation of medical coding could generate annual savings of $122 billion, while noting that coding errors are a significant source of operational inefficiency, with 42% of claim denials attributable to coding issues.
keyFindings: AI automation of medical coding could produce potential annual savings of $122 billion across the healthcare industry.
Coding issues account for 42% of all claim denials in healthcare systems.
qualifiers: Only abstract/excerpt available; limited detail on study scope, sample size, data sources, or analytical methods. The term 'potential' indicates these figures represent projections rather than observed results.
